what: Pins the stage of a tall section (original footer 300lvh) to the screen. While passing, n large background scenes slide up one at a time with the picture inside flowing backward 40%, and the n pictures in the small center photo box come down from above in the opposite direction, staggered. At the end the small box shows the first picture and the big panel the last.

options.drift: How far the image inside the panel flows in reverse (%), default 40
options.--fx-gap: Gap between small photos (css variable, on the small-cell box), default 1rem
options.[data-fx-part=back]: One large scene (stacked vertically inside a 100% height box) — first child is the image
options.[data-fx-part=front]: One photo inside a small cell (the small cell clips overflow) — first child is the image

use:
×3
×3

from.where: shared.js footer (.sc-foot) — pebble·tile plate·triangle tile background with a small photo in the center
